name: Worldforged Scorpionscale Mantle stands only in Silithus, not the Valley of Trials (#9179)
contract: Item 410068 (Scorpionscale Mantle, item level 57, pickup template 518462) belongs to the Silithus worldforged set (its sibling 410065 Idol of Shifting Sands was fixed the same way by #6485/PR #9610). The Silithus copy (guid 6942146, map 1, -8106.8,970.1,59.503) is correct. The realm-map migration also placed a second copy, guid 6942147, inside the Valley of Trials starting zone (map 1, -341.6,-4344.9,59.937), handing a level 56-57 item to level 1-5 orc/troll starters. Remove the Valley of Trials copy; the Silithus copy is untouched.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: no misplaced mantle copy in the Valley of Trials
the mantle stands at its recorded Silithus spot
